title: Current-session pointer
description: <root>/current/<harness>/<first 16 hex of sha256(clean cwd)>.json: the session a harness's hooks last named in a directory, which the MCP server (started per project) reads to know which session a memory call is about. Written atomically on every hook. Source: memory/cli/session.go (Session, pointerPath, remember, current).

format.description: A transcript reader name (transcript.Formats or transcript.DBFormats).
